crossRefs.note: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

parallels.note: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

people.name: Amaziah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Joash

translations.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
translations.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
translations.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
